offers.title: You are just what this node ...
offers.description: You are just what this node wanted. Please stand by for an assignment:. This very hour, we intercepted a message that a prototype Right-Hand Implant: Weapon Smt, Shiny will be moved from the a house to another secret hideout. If you could describe the item to us in detail (by picking it up!) we will let you keep it - plus a large sum of money and experience. I am sorry to say that we do not know exactly where it can be found, only that it is within an area called Trade District. You will have to ask around to find the playfield. I am sure that such a distinguished Shade Solitus as Illumination is not deterred by the lack of information, but sees it as a challenge! Take care now.

offers.title: Every year mutants crawl out...
offers.description: Every year mutants crawl out of their hideout in Lush Fields.  Someone had grown tired of the situation and would like you to go to a building and take care of the problem.  Add some good old Spiked Food Sacks to the Theft Secure Food Dispenser to make them docile enough through this breeding season, and get out of there as soon as possible before 48 hours.
